retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 1970s soul aesthetic featuring a central prop-based subject enveloped in thick atmospheric smoke and topped with vibrant hand-drawn script.

recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, atmospheric composition where a central object (like a microphone strapped to dynamite) sits in a hazy, smoke-filled environment. The scene is dominated by a large, fluid hand-written signature in a neon-adjacent green, contrasting with a secondary blocky title in red.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant green script floats atop the hazy smoke background.
The red title at the top mirrors the red of the dynamite sticks below.
The central prop is the focal point of the lower half, while the smoke fills the upper half.
coreInvariants: Thick, billowing white and grey smoke
Analog film grain and slight soft focus
Vibrant, saturated green for the primary script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central prop in the lower third; large script spanning the upper middle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bundle of red dynamite sticks and microphone.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top red title, down through the green script, following the smoke trails to the central prop.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Filled with atmospheric smoke and hazy textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted, smoky greys and dark browns (background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on text and key props against a desaturated, hazy background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, green, white, and dark earth tones.

letterConstructionRules: Primary script: Fluid, continuous strokes with varying thickness, mimicking a felt-tip marker.
Secondary title: Wide, geometric, all-caps sans-serif with heavy tracking.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'J' in the script have long, sweeping tails.
The 'o' and 'n' characters are tightly looped and rhythmic.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between a rigid, wide geometric sans and a loose, organic script.

preserve: Wide letter spacing for the top title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, blocky secondary title style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a microphone strapped to a bundle of red dynamite sticks on a dark surface, surrounded by thick, billowing white smoke with a vintage 1970s film grain and warm lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a wide-tracked red geometric sans-serif title at the very top. In the center, overlay a large, vibrant lime green hand-written script that appears to float in front of the smoke.

verificationChecks: Is the green script vibrant and fluid?
Is the smoke thick and atmospheric?
Is the top title wide-spaced and red?
Does the image have a 1970s analog film quality?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the green script doesn't have a digital 'glow' but looks like ink.
Verify the red title is perfectly horizontal and wide-spaced.
Confirm the smoke interacts naturally with the lighting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [atmospheric smoke photography] + [central prop focal point] + [vibrant hand-drawn script] + [wide-tracked geometric header].
